measurements.evidence_quote: The zeta potential of the PS-MPs was -76±1.2 mV. || The average hydrodynamic size, polydispersity index (PDI) and zeta potential of the PS-MPs were determined by dynamic laser scattering (DLS) (Zetasizer Nano ZS90). Briefly, we used PS-MPs stock solution (4% wt/vol) to prepare a final concentration of 75-μg/mL PS-MPs solution in ultrapure water. || 1-mL aliquots of the well-mixed solution were placed into cuvettes and the solutions were analyzed with DLS in triplicate.
